tagline: 理光便携相机，1990 年发布
description: 理光于1990年推出的便携相机。配备35mm f/3.5, 4 elements in 4 groups。快门速度1/4 - 1/400 sec.。感光度ISO 100 - 1600 (DX-code system)。Active Spot AF, 6 focusing steps, 0.8 m - inf.。

specs.对焦: Active Spot AF, 6 focusing steps, 0.8 m - inf.
specs.英文简介: The Ricoh FF-9s is a compact camera with an 1:3.5 f=35mm lens which is protected by a sliding door when the camera is switched off.
